title: SoilGrids and soil depth intervals
summary: Global modelled soil properties at 250 m resolution across six standard depth intervals.
body: The intervals 0–5, 5–15, 15–30, 30–60, 60–100 and 100–200 cm are sampling depths, not excavated archaeological horizons. Texture percentages describe sand, silt and clay; bulk density and organic carbon describe other soil properties. These estimates cannot locate artefacts or date a cultural layer. Official REST availability is currently limited; this app also provides an explicit WCS acquisition script.
